globalOptions.name: --repo-root
globalOptions.summary: Run local-agent commands against a different repo root than the current working directory.

commands.name: start
commands.summary: Open the founder cockpit for guided local-agent flows.

commands.name: help-me
commands.summary: Show beginner-safe workflows and reminders.

commands.name: next
commands.summary: Recommend one safe next command from local state.

commands.name: explain-commands
commands.summary: Explain the command map in plain English.

commands.name: command-registry
commands.summary: Write the machine-readable command registry for future UI consumers.

commands.name: doctor
commands.summary: Write doctor-report and model-runtime-status artifacts from current local state and local model health.
commands.example: pnpm run tf:local-agent -- doctor --model-endpoint http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1 --model-name local-coder

commands.name: model-health
commands.summary: Check whether the configured local model gateway is reachable without granting tool authority.
commands.example: pnpm run tf:local-agent -- model-health --model-endpoint http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1 --model-name local-coder

commands.name: list-models
commands.summary: List models exposed by the configured local loopback gateway.

commands.name: model-chat
commands.summary: Send a zero-authority advisory chat prompt to the configured local loopback model gateway.
commands.example: pnpm run tf:local-agent -- model-chat --model-endpoint http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1 --message "Summarize the locked card risks"

commands.name: control-center-state
commands.summary: Write the read-only control-center contract for future UI layers.

commands.name: control-center-preview
commands.summary: Render the read-only terminal preview from the control-center state contract.

commands.name: release-notes
commands.summary: Write CHANGELOG.md and 0.1.0 release note artifacts.

commands.name: docs-index
commands.summary: Write the release reading path and required artifact index.

commands.name: product-manifest
commands.summary: Write the runtime shipping contract and release governance posture.

commands.name: release-check
commands.summary: Validate release evidence artifacts before shipping.

commands.name: release-freeze
commands.summary: Fingerprint the current release evidence bundle and record the rerun gates for the frozen founder launch state.

commands.name: ship-mvp
commands.summary: Run the MVP release evidence spine and create a release evidence bundle; does not approve, tag, or push.

commands.name: tag-gate
commands.summary: Validate release-tag readiness without creating the git tag.

commands.name: release-approve
commands.summary: Record human release owner approval after Tag Gate passes, without creating a git tag.

commands.name: tag-command
commands.summary: Print the final manual git tag command after release approval, without executing it.

commands.name: release-runbook
commands.summary: Write the final human release runbook after tag gate, approval, and tag command reports.

commands.name: plan
commands.summary: Create a bounded work card without mutating repository state.
commands.example: pnpm run tf:local-agent -- plan "Describe your task here"

commands.name: lock-card
commands.summary: Lock a bounded work card before patching.
commands.example: pnpm run tf:local-agent -- lock-card "Describe your task here"

commands.name: current-card
commands.summary: Show the currently locked work card.

commands.name: clear-card
commands.summary: Clear the currently locked work card.

commands.name: preview-patch
commands.summary: Create a patch preview under the locked-card boundary.

commands.name: show-patch
commands.summary: Display a previously created patch preview.

commands.name: apply-patch
commands.summary: Apply a previewed patch only with explicit approval.

commands.name: proof
commands.summary: Run proof gates for the locked work card.

commands.name: explain
commands.summary: Render a read-only explanation from locked-card, proof, save-state, and local-agent artifact context.

commands.name: review
commands.summary: Render a read-only review of risks, pending patches, proof posture, and finalize blockers.

commands.name: save-state
commands.summary: Write founder handoff state for the current run.
commands.example: pnpm run tf:local-agent -- save-state "Summarize what happened" --next-step "Write the next exact action"

commands.name: finalize
commands.summary: Declare completion only after locked card, proof, and save state exist.

commands.name: tool
commands.summary: Run advanced governed tool commands under the founder policy.
